GLRK.feature.title: Recall Knowledge
GLRK.feature.hint: Author a three-tier lore ladder for any actor, journal, item or scene with Claude, then read back the right slice of it at the table according to the roller's competence band. GM-facing; nothing is posted to players.
GLRK.app.title: Recall Knowledge
GLRK.tier.everyone.label: Everyone knows
GLRK.tier.everyone.brief: What it is, and what it is known for.
GLRK.tier.might.label: One might know
GLRK.tier.might.brief: How it fights and how it dies.
GLRK.tier.few.label: Very few know
GLRK.read.pickBand: Pick the roller's competence band to see what you may tell them.
GLRK.reveal.mistakenFor: They are fairly sure it is {name}, and will act on that.
GLRK.reveal.nothingComesToMind: Nothing comes to mind. They draw a blank.
GLRK.reveal.wrongSource.mistaken: No misremembered line was written, so a similar real creature was chosen. It will stay this one.
GLRK.reveal.hint.hedged: Deliver this with visible uncertainty — half-remembered, hedged, possibly garbled in the telling.
GLRK.reveal.hint.lead: Add a nudge that there is more to know, without spending {tier}.
GLRK.reveal.hint.bonus: The ladder is fully spent. Add something of your own: a secret, a hook, or an answer to whatever they actually asked.
GLRK.generate.contextHint: The single most useful field here. Campaign specifics, what the party already knows, who lied to them, the tone you want. Saved with the subject, so regenerating does not mean retyping.
GLRK.generate.contextPlaceholder: The party already met a barrow-wight. The Hillfolk elder lied to them about what is buried here.
GLRK.generate.extra.folder: Other documents in the same folder
GLRK.generate.seedFound: Existing Recall Knowledge notes from Statblock Import will be offered as raw material.
GLRK.generate.pasteHint: Paste Claude's answer here exactly as it came back. Fences, stray commentary and bold lead-ins are all fine.
GLRK.confirm.overwrite.title: Replace the existing ladder?
GLRK.confirm.overwrite.body: This subject already has a ladder. Replacing it cannot be undone.
GLRK.confirm.clear.title: Delete this ladder?
GLRK.confirm.clear.body: The stored lore for this subject will be removed.
GLRK.notify.copied: Prompt copied ({chars} characters). Paste it into Claude.
GLRK.notify.copyFailed: Clipboard blocked — the prompt was placed in the paste box below; copy it manually.
GLRK.notify.unsupported: That document type cannot be summarised.
GLRK.notify.parseFailed: Could not read that as a ladder.
GLRK.parse.warn.noVersion: No version marker found — stored anyway, but check the tiers landed correctly.
GLRK.parse.warn.versionMismatch: This ladder was written against a different grammar version.
GLRK.parse.warn.noTitle: No title line found; the subject's own name was used.
GLRK.parse.warn.extraMisremembered: More than one misremembered line was given; only the first was kept.
GLRK.parse.warn.noMisremembered: No misremembered line. Badly failed rolls will fall back to mistaken identity.
GLRK.parse.error.noHeadings: None of the expected tier headings were found.
GLRK.settings.mistakenIdentity.name: Mistaken identity fallback
GLRK.settings.mistakenIdentity.hint: When a creature has no written misremembered line, a badly failed roll names a real, similar creature instead. The choice is cached so the same creature stays mistaken for the same thing.
GLRK.settings.sheetButton.name: Show the sheet header button
GLRK.settings.sheetButton.hint: Adds a Recall Knowledge control to actor, journal, item and scene sheets. The sidebar right-click entry is always available.
GLRK.reveal.hint.blank: Give them nothing. They are far enough out of their depth that the question does not connect — play the blank, do not invent a lie.
